comment: weapon.c add_skills_to_menu() 1272-1273: a debug elven Wizard (St 6) wears a wished +99 elven mithril-coat, raises her maximum HP with blessed full healing, puts on a +20 ring of increase accuracy and wields an uncursed -2 mace, whose skill (max Basic for Wizards) she trains while Unskilled: each hit deals 1 damage and trains when dmgval exceeds 1. She fights three created mastodons (#wizkill removes each one once it flees; one death is declined at the wizard-mode 'Die?' prompt) until mace practice reaches 85, advances mace to Basic with #enhance, and opens #enhance again: the mace is at its maximum with practice >= 80, so peaked_skill() marks it '  # ' (1273). The final ESC closes the menu.
